summary.en: Semiconductors lead today: TSMC's 2nm risk production starts ahead of plan, while regulation enters the picture as the EU begins enforcing its AI Act.
summary.zh: 今天半导体是主轴：台积电 2 纳米风险试产进度超前；与此同时，欧盟开始执行《AI 法案》，监管正式入场。

bullets.en: TSMC N2 enters risk production, defect density tracking below N3.
bullets.zh: 台积电 N2 进入风险试产，缺陷密度低于 N3。

bullets.en: EU opens its first enforcement window for high-risk AI systems.
bullets.zh: 欧盟开启高风险 AI 系统的首个执法窗口。

title.zh: 台积电启动 2 纳米试产

whats_new.en: TSMC began N2 risk production at Fab 20.
whats_new.zh: 台积电在 Fab 20 启动 N2 风险试产。

why_it_matters.en: N2 is the first GAA node.
why_it_matters.zh: N2 是首个 GAA 节点。

key_details.en: Early defect density tracks below N3.
key_details.zh: 早期缺陷密度低于 N3。

background.zh: GAA 取代自 2011 年沿用的 FinFET。

discussion.en: Commenters are skeptical of the framing.
discussion.zh: 评论者对该说法持保留态度。

title.en: EU enforces high-risk AI Act provisions
title.zh: 欧盟执行《AI 法案》高风险条款

whats_new.en: First enforcement window opened this week.
whats_new.zh: 首个执法窗口本周开启。

why_it_matters.en: Fines up to 7% of global revenue.
